purpose: Audit storage by table in CUSTOM MySQL
sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, TABLE_ROWS, ROUND(DATA_LENGTH/1024/1024,2) data_mb, ROUND(INDEX_LENGTH/1024/1024,2) index_mb, ROUND((DATA_LENGTH+INDEX_LENGTH)/1024/1024,2) total_mb, ROUND(AVG_ROW_LENGTH/1024,2) avg_row_kb FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() ORDER BY (DATA_LENGTH+INDEX_LENGTH) DESC
